title: A variable can hold a table and be used as a CALCULATE filter
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR RedProducts = FILTER ( Product, Product[Color] = "Red" ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], RedProducts ) )

source.quote: One important detail about variables, though not clear at first sight, is that variables can contain tables too.
source.supports: a variable can hold a table

source.quote: a variable containing a table inherits the relationships of the base tables of the columns it contains
source.supports: the rows of Product in the variable filter Sales through the relationship

derivation: RedProducts holds Bike (1) and Helmet (2). As a filter it restricts Product to those rows, and Sales through ProductKey to rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7: 100 + 40 + 20 + 200 + 100 = 460.
